# MENASCO Services

> MENASCO services: MEP engineering and installation, EPC turnkey delivery, data centers, civil works and BIM, and off-site manufacturing and prefabrication.

MEP works form the foundation of our expertise, supported by a broad range of complementary capabilities to meet complex project requirements. Strategic civil partnerships enable unified delivery of wider construction scopes, while established procurement networks and exclusive vendor relationships strengthen our EPC offering. With fabrication capabilities across three countries and specialized expertise in data centers and mission-critical infrastructure, we deliver projects ranging from modular MEP installations to highly redundant, technically demanding facilities.

## Services

### MEP

- [MEP Services: Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing](https://menascogroup.com/services/mep/llms.txt): Mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection by MENASCO: BIM-coordinated installation, testing and commissioning, with 350+ MEP projects delivered.

#### Mechanical Systems

Mechanical systems control the temperature, air quality and ventilation of a building. Typical scope includes chilled-water distribution and pumping, air handling units and fan coil units, supply, return and fresh-air ductwork, smoke extraction and stair pressurisation, and plant room installation. In hot climates, cooling loads drive much of the design, so pipework sizing, insulation and testing, adjusting and balancing (TAB) are critical to reliable, energy-efficient operation.

Scope of works:

- HVAC & Ventilation Systems
- Chilled-Water & District Cooling Systems
- Air-Cooled & Water-Cooled Chiller Systems
- CRAC (Computer Room Air Conditioner)
- CRAH (Computer Room Air Handler)
- Mechanical Plant Rooms
- Pumps, Heat Exchangers & Cooling Towers
- Air Distribution & Ductwork Systems
- Smoke Extraction & Staircase Pressurisation Systems
- Building Management & HVAC Control Systems
- Off-Site Prefabricated Modular MEP Solutions
- Prefabricated Modular Mechanical Systems
- Refrigeration & Cold-Room Systems
- Compressed-Air Systems
- Industrial, LPG & Medical Gas Systems
- Cleanroom & Controlled-Environment Systems
- Wastewater & Water-Treatment Systems
- Steam & Boiler Systems
- Testing, Adjusting & Balancing (TAB)
- Testing and Commissioning

#### Electrical & ELV

Electrical systems distribute power safely from the incoming supply to every outlet, light and piece of equipment. Typical scope covers MV and LV switchgear, main and sub-main distribution boards, busbar trunking, cable containment, standby generators and UPS, lighting and lighting control, and earthing and lightning protection. Extra-low-voltage (ELV) systems such as structured cabling, CCTV, access control and public address are installed alongside, then tested and integrated before handover.

Scope of works:

- Medium-Voltage & Low-Voltage Electrical Systems
- Electrical Substations & Transformer Systems
- Prefabricated Power E-Houses
- MV and LV Switchgear & Distribution Panels
- Main & Sub-Main Distribution Boards
- Power Distribution & Containment Systems
- Busbar & Busduct Systems
- Standby Generators & Emergency Power Systems
- Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) Systems
- Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) Systems
- Small & Medium Reactors (SMR)
- Microgrids & Resilient Power Structures
- Lighting & Lighting-Control Systems
- Emergency & Specialist Lighting Systems
- Earthing, Grounding & Lightning Protection Systems
- Power-Factor Correction & Harmonic-Filtration Systems
- Building Management Systems (BMS)
- Structured Cabling and ICT Infrastructure
- CCTV and Video-Surveillance Systems
- Access-Control & Intrusion-Detection Systems
- Public Address & Voice-Alarm Systems (PAVA)
- Voice-Evacuation Systems
- Audio-Visual (AV) Systems
- Instrumentation & Control Systems

#### Plumbing, Water & Drainage

Plumbing and drainage systems supply clean water and remove wastewater and stormwater from a building. Typical scope includes cold and hot water distribution, water storage tanks and booster pump sets, soil, waste and vent pipework, rainwater drainage, sewage lifting stations, and water treatment such as reverse osmosis and greywater recycling. Pipe materials, falls and pressure zones are set during design, and every system is pressure tested, flushed and disinfected before use.

Scope of works:

- Domestic Cold & Hot Water Supply Systems
- Water Storage & Distribution Systems
- Water-Pressure Booster Pump Systems
- Sanitary Drainage & Wastewater Systems
- Soil, Waste & Vent Systems
- Stormwater & Rainwater Drainage Systems
- Sewage-Lifting & Transfer Pumping Stations
- Sanitary Fixtures & Accessories Installation
- PVC, PPR, HDPE, Copper & Stainless-Steel Pipework
- Irrigation & Landscape Water Systems
- Greywater & Blackwater Treatment Systems
- Greywater Recycling & Reuse Systems
- Reverse Osmosis (RO) Water-Treatment Systems
- Water Filtration & Purification Systems
- Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)
- Grease, Oil & Sand Interceptor Systems
- Hot-Water Generation & Circulation Systems
- Solar Water-Heating Systems
- Water Metering & Leak-Detection Systems
- Swimming Pool, Fountain & Water-Feature Systems
- Testing, Flushing, Disinfection & Commissioning

#### Fire Protection & Life Safety

Fire protection and life safety systems detect a fire, alert occupants and control its spread. Typical scope includes addressable fire alarm and detection, wet and dry sprinkler systems, fire hydrant and hose reel networks, fire pump sets, clean-agent gas suppression for server and electrical rooms, and kitchen hood suppression. These systems interface with smoke control, emergency lighting and voice evacuation. In the UAE, they are designed, inspected and approved in line with Civil Defence requirements; in other markets, designs are fitted to the fire codes and standards of that country.

Scope of works:

- Fire Detection & Alarm Systems
- Sprinkler Systems
- Fire Hydrant & Hose Reel Systems
- Fire Pump Sets & Water Storage
- Clean-Agent & Gas Suppression Systems
- Foam Suppression Systems
- Kitchen Hood Suppression Systems
- Smoke Control Interfaces
- Emergency Lighting Interfaces
- Voice Evacuation Interfaces
- Fire Extinguishers & Fire Blankets
- Testing, Witnessing & Civil Defence Approvals

### EPC

- [EPC — Engineering, Procurement & Construction](https://menascogroup.com/services/turnkey-developments/llms.txt): MENASCO delivers integrated Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) services, providing a single point of accountability from design through handover.

- Engineering Design & BIM Coordination: In-house MEP design and model coordination establishing a clash-free technical basis before construction begins.
- Procurement & Supply-Chain Coordination: Equipment and materials procurement coordinated against the project programme to keep delivery on schedule.
- Site Mobilisation & Construction Management: On-site teams and subcontractors mobilised and managed under a single point of accountability.
- Installation, Testing & Commissioning: MEP systems installed, tested and commissioned against project specifications and standards.
- Project Scheduling & Progress Reporting: Programme management and transparent progress reporting throughout delivery.
- Quality Assurance & HSE Compliance: Quality and HSE processes embedded across design, procurement and site execution.

### Data Centers

- [Data Center MEP Contractor | Tier III & Tier IV](https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers/llms.txt): Data center MEP by MENASCO: Tier III and Tier IV topologies, CRAC and CRAH cooling, UPS and generator resilience, for greenfield and brownfield sites.

- Complete MEP Solutions: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection for white space, grey space and support areas, coordinated in a federated BIM model and commissioned as one package.
- Critical Power Infrastructure: MV and LV switchgear, transformers, substations and power E-Houses, generators, UPS and A/B distribution to the rack, in N+1 and 2N topologies with provision for SMRs.
- Cooling & Precision HVAC Systems: Chilled-water plant, CRAH/CRAC units and aisle containment, plus coolant distribution units and secondary loops for direct-to-chip liquid cooling, sized to ASHRAE conditions.
- Modular Whitespace Fabrication: Prefabricated white space modules, pipe racks, corridor modules, plantroom skids and riser assemblies, built and tested off site, then delivered on a sequenced logistics plan.
- BMS, Automation, Security & ELV: BMS, power monitoring (EPMS) and PLC controls with alarming and DCIM integration, plus structured cabling, access control, CCTV, intrusion detection and fire alarm interfaces.
- Civil and Enabling Works: Site preparation, excavation, foundations, equipment plinths, cable trenches, duct banks, drainage and builder's works, sequenced with MEP installation to protect the programme.
- Scalable & Future-Ready Infrastructure: Engineering flexible and scalable infrastructure solutions designed to support future expansion, technology upgrades & evolving operational demands.

### Civil & BIM

- [Civil Works Coordination](https://menascogroup.com/services/civil/llms.txt): MENASCO coordinates civil and structural works with our MEP delivery through a trusted civil engineering partner, from design through handover.

- Site Works & Enabling Coordination: Groundworks, utilities and site infrastructure aligned with our civil partner ahead of construction.
- Structural Interface Coordination: Structural penetrations, plant-room foundations and builder's work coordinated with MEP design.
- BIM-Based Clash Detection: Civil and MEP models coordinated in a shared environment to resolve clashes before site works begin.
- Underground Services Coordination: Drainage, water and electrical routing coordinated with civil infrastructure and utility works.
- Project Scheduling & Progress Reporting: Civil and MEP programmes aligned and tracked together across the project.
- Quality Assurance & HSE Compliance: Quality and HSE processes maintained consistently across civil and building-services scope.

### Manufacturing & Prefabrication

- [MEP Prefabrication](https://menascogroup.com/services/manufacturing-prefabrication/llms.txt): MENASCO delivers off-site MEP prefabrication, including ductwork, pipe fabrication and prefabricated modules, for faster, higher-quality construction.

- HVAC Ductwork Fabrication: Precision-manufactured ductwork engineered for performance, efficiency, and seamless installation.
- Prefabricated MEP Modules: Factory-built assemblies that improve coordination, quality, and construction speed.
- Pipe Rack Systems: Integrated piping assemblies manufactured to reduce installation time and improve consistency.
- Modular Data Center Solutions: Prefabricated support solutions for data center whitespaces.
- Electrical Containment: Prefabricated containment systems produced for accurate installation and improved coordination.
- Custom Engineered Components: Project-specific manufacturing solutions tailored to complex engineering requirements.

## How we deliver

Join at any stage, from first drawing to handover.

- Early engagement: Join during design for technical reviews, procurement planning and early constructability input.
- BIM coordination: Federated models resolve clashes and validate every installation before work reaches site.
- Strategic sourcing: Established supplier networks secure equipment and materials to specification and schedule.
- Site installation: Components prefabricated across three countries are installed with less congestion and rework.
- Testing & handover: Integrated systems are tested, commissioned and documented for a clean handover to operations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What services does MENASCO provide?

MEP contracting forms the core of MENASCO's operations, supported by civil and structural partnerships, manufacturing and prefabrication, and integrated EPC delivery. Specialized capabilities also extend to data centers and mission-critical infrastructure, allowing clients to consolidate multiple technical and construction requirements under a coordinated delivery structure.

### Can MENASCO deliver both MEP and civil works under a single contract?

Yes. Through established partnerships with specialist civil contractors, MENASCO can coordinate and deliver combined civil and MEP scopes under a unified contracting arrangement. This approach simplifies project interfaces, improves coordination between disciplines, and provides clients with a clearer structure for project accountability.

### What distinguishes MENASCO's EPC capabilities from traditional contracting?

EPC delivery combines design management, procurement, construction, and commissioning under a single delivery framework. Established supplier networks, strategic vendor relationships, and multidisciplinary project management capabilities allow MENASCO to manage complex procurement requirements and coordinate specialist contractors while maintaining oversight of cost, schedule, and technical compliance.

### Does MENASCO offer off-site manufacturing and prefabrication?

Yes. Manufacturing capabilities across three countries support the fabrication and modular assembly of MEP components away from active construction sites. Prefabrication can reduce on-site installation requirements, improve production consistency, and support more predictable construction schedules, particularly on projects with repetitive or technically complex installations.

### What data center infrastructure can MENASCO deliver?

Capabilities include high-capacity substations, resilient electrical distribution, backup power infrastructure, precision cooling, fire protection, and specialized environmental systems. Cooling solutions can incorporate conventional air-cooled and chilled-water technologies alongside advanced direct-to-chip liquid cooling, depending on the facility's design and operational requirements.

### Can MENASCO support Tier III and Tier IV data center developments?

Yes. MENASCO supports greenfield and brownfield data center projects designed to meet Uptime Institute Tier III and Tier IV requirements. Delivery focuses on the integration of redundant power, cooling, and critical infrastructure systems, alongside the technical coordination, testing, and commissioning necessary to support the facility's certification objectives. Formal certification remains subject to independent assessment by Uptime Institute.

### At what stage of a project can MENASCO become involved?

Engagement can begin during design development, preconstruction, or the construction phase, depending on the contracting arrangement. Early involvement enables technical reviews, procurement planning, BIM coordination, constructability assessments, and identification of potential installation or system integration challenges before site execution.

### Where does MENASCO operate?

MENASCO maintains an international presence spanning the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, the United Kingdom, the United States, Jordan, and Syria. Engineering, procurement, fabrication, and project delivery resources are coordinated across these markets according to project requirements, local regulations, and client needs.
